heading: Today
text: Some low clouds and fog, then periods of sun.  Localized afternoon showers, mostly from the Green Mountains east, the best chance in NH.  Highs in the 60s to near 70 north, low to mid 70s south.  Light winds, mainly north up to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds from Rt. 4 and the White Mountains north, with scattered showers, ending late.  Partly cloudy west and south.  Cooler.  Patchy valley fog.  Lows in the 40s to low 50s.  Winds north near 10 mph, diminishing to light outside the Champlain Valley.

heading: Sunday
text: Areas of valley fog, then sunshine, mixing with clouds, especially in the afternoon through the mountains.  Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s north, low to mid 70s in the Champlain Valley and south.  Light winds, mainly north up to 10 mph.
